leastChangeRoute.mechanism: Normal installed CLI OAuth implementation, without wrapper: fresh GEMINI_CLI_HOME plus GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS pointing to the existing OAuth file; explicit oauth-personal selection in a per-run system-settings override.
leastChangeRoute.whyItWorksLocally: The non-encrypted OAuth reader tries its own Storage credential path first, then the supplied GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS path. A fresh isolated home has no first credential file, so the native owner can read the existing file itself. Operator does not open/copy its contents.
leastChangeRoute.writeDestination: CLI project registry, history, session logs, account metadata, cache and token-refresh cache are under <CONTROL>/gemini-home/.gemini; TMPDIR separately directs OS temporary files.
leastChangeRoute.credentialSideEffect: During a future authorized invocation, normal OAuth refresh may write credentials with mode0600 inside the private per-run home. This is native auth behavior, not operator credential copying. Keep that directory outside review artifacts/output.
leastChangeRoute.normalHomeAlternative: Leaving GEMINI_CLI_HOME unset reuses OAuth but also writes CLI storage beneath the existing ~/.gemini; no separate general cache/session-root override was established. The supported credential-path fallback is the smaller route.

precedence.settingsOrder: schema defaults < system defaults < isolated user settings < trusted frozen-packet workspace settings < per-run system settings; CLI model/policy/MCP flags then select their explicit fields.
precedence.arrayBehavior: tools.core and modelConfigs.customOverrides have no concat/union annotation; later per-run system arrays replace earlier arrays. ModelConfigService adds the selected custom overrides after built-in overrides; the exact-model HIGH override is explicit.
precedence.adminCorrection: Local admin.* is recomputed from defaults plus remote-admin input and is not used as the isolation control.
precedence.toolPolicy: Use --admin-policy for the exact deny-all998/allow-four999 file. Current fixed system policy directory is absent. Supplemental admin policy is tier5 and overrides built-in plan write/subagent/exit allowances and user-tier rules. If fixed system .toml policy appears, installed CLI ignores supplemental --admin-policy; rebind rather than silently proceed.
precedence.toolCoreLimit: Core allowlist enforcement rules exclude plan mode, so tools.core alone is insufficient here. Explicit policy has no mode restriction.
precedence.extensionsMcpHooks: --extensions none; hooksConfig.enabled=false; isolated settings contain no MCP servers; CLI exact allowlist uses an unconfigured sentinel to exclude other discovered/admin-injected server names. A matching unexpected sentinel or altered tool inventory is a refusal, not assumed confinement.

sources.meaning: OAuth reader tries Storage.getOAuthCredsPath then GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS; refresh persists under Storage and suppressed-browser noninteractive failure does not start manual login.
GEMINI_CLI_HOME owns .gemini storage; OAuth, account, registry, session/cache/history derive from it. TMPDIR alone does not redirect this storage.
Actual ordered settings merge, array replacement without concat/union annotation, and admin recomputation from defaults/remote settings.
Current CLI imports this settings owner; explicit policy/MCP flags override settings; NO_BROWSER; selected auth method and enforced type.
Custom model overrides merge after built-in overrides; policy tiers and guard; core allowlist policy applies only outside plan; exact MCP allowlist blocks other server names.
Headless existing cached authentication route is documented.
